title: Geologic and geomorphic elements of the lower Congaree River floodplain, central South Carolina
citation: Shelley, D.C., and Cohen, A.D., 2007, Geologic and geomorphic elements of the lower Congaree River floodplain, central South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Map Series MS-27, map scale 1:12,000.
notes: MS-27 (Shelley and Cohen, 2007), lower Congaree River flood plain at 1:12,000. Page 1 is the plate (about 9750 x 2700 pt); page 2 is the explanation text, from which units, ages and thicknesses are recorded. Several symbols are garbled in OCR and only those cited cleanly in the text are recorded. Hand and power auger hole labels on the plate are too small for this pass and are queued for an image re-read; third-party geotechnical site identifiers are not recorded. SUBSURFACE: hole 09-247 (17+ ft fan deposits) and Boundary Road holes (4-8 ft clay top stratum) from the text.
